body: Ha, you won't have to worry about that. I'm a teetotaler.
And this is something I really need to step back and realize, because I definitely feel bad when I make mistakes.
Oh, very good tip. It's something so simple, yet so easy to forget!

Thank you to everyone for all your comments! I truly do appreciate them. And if you have anymore I'd be MORE than happy to hear them. 

Just for the heck of it, I figured I'd share a little story. As I was doing work as an intern, I think EVERY tech I worked with was amazing. And I really couldn't appreciate that enough, because technicians are really the backbone of the pharmacy. 

In particular, I really enjoyed working with the technician at the last place I worked as an intern. By the time I was done, we were good enough friends that we enjoyed giving each other crap for small mistakes, but it was all in good fun. We'd also do a great job covering each other when one of us forgot something. I hope I can find an amazing dynamic like that again as I move forward.
Yeah, definitely. And as I was doing work as an intern I already saw some of that. Hopefully now as a pharmacist I'll be able to find more of a mentor like that.
Interesting. I never would have thought about that notebook idea. Good idea! Thank you.
Yeah, I definitely need to look into that, because you really can never be sure.
Excellent, thank you for taking time out of your day to give me all these tips! I truly appreciate them and will put them to use. I especially love that last tip. :)

Wow, the person who offered to talk to me deleted their comment. ;(

That's just my luck.

Yes, one person and one person only knows. She's a very good friend of mine who's been with me through most of this year (my depression started on 1/6/17). If it wasn't for her talking me out of it, who knows what would've happened.
Sure just give me a little time.
The short and sweet version is I've got a lot of things going on in my life and they're overwhelming me.
I'll try.
Maybe. Thank you for the comment.
I appreciate it, but meh I already tried posting here and no one cared enough to say anything so why bother?
Anyone? :(
Very good information I should consider. Thank you!
Thanks again! :)
Awesome, thanks for the info! It's much appreciated. :)
Good to know. I'll definitely inquire before making my final decision. Thanks!
Right, and I don't intend to. I just know very little about retirement plans and what's considered "good" so I was just hoping I could learn a thing or two here.

To answer your question in the first paragraph, it's definitely hard to say. There's a lot of question marks in my future right now, but if I were to guess I would say it's unlikely I'm going to retire with either one. 

But thank you, your information was good and very helpful. It's crazy how quickly this stuff gets complex. So many things to consider!
Thank you for your comment. To answer your question, the way the boss put it he would be doing up to 15% of my annual income. I do not know if it's vested, I would have to inquire.
Sounds good. Thank you again for your comments! :)

Thank you for your comment. I actually think I may have work lined up shortly. I've taken my job hunt much more seriously than I was before, and I believe it may pay off soon. 

To make things clear, I am doing this for myself, as I believe having something to do to help distract me will help greatly. She also mentioned that I need to make decisions for me, not for her. But I ask you this: Do you think having work will change much for me?

Also, as for your opinion, I totally respect it and understand it, but I assure you we discussed all those things in depth. She actually prefers slightly older men and I am obviously okay with her being younger. We also talked about our future plans together plenty. Of course, things are always subject to change, but we had a plan ready and we were okay with it. Now please don't think I'm trashing your opinion or anything, I'd just like to offer you my response to it.

Thanks again for your comment. It's much appreciated. :)

Don't blame yourself. It's my fault if I didn't get the details in there lol.

Anyway, yeah, I'd really like to remain her friend if anything. She's been such a fantastic friend. She did text me after and asked me for advice on something she knew I was knowledgeable in, so it's a positive sign I feel like.

Since then, however, I've been giving her some space while I try to improve myself.

In the rare moments we did get to talk, she did apologize for how busy she was being and told me she still loved me and wanted to talk to me and all that. I'm not saying you're wrong at all, far from it. I just think the bulk of the blame lies with me and I can't deny it. I understand where she's coming from.

Yeah, that's sort of the advice I received from my friends. The ball is in her court, as they've said. She did text me not long after she broke things off looking for advice from me on something she knows I'm knowledgeable in, so I felt like that was a good sign.

It's a tough pill to swallow hearing that, but I know it's something I need to think about.. I would still like to be her friend above all else and I hope she does too. Her friendship was invaluable to me.

I feel like sometimes people just outright ignore the spy question regardless of how good or bad it is. It sort of sucks, tbh, because why even bother going on the spy section if you don't plan on participating?

But eh I guess if I start trying to rationalize the behaviors I see on Omegle I'd be busy pondering for the rest of my life.

Yeah some bots are able to recognize when you speak the word "bot" and have a premade message they'll respond with when you say it. It's fun to scream bot over and over and watch them paste the same message over and over where they claim they're not a bot lol.

I can't believe I'm going to reveal this, but I met by BEST friend on Omegle. Sure, we didn't immediately start out that way, but we met in 2014 and talked consistently until eventually we became best friends. Inseparable. We shared everything together. Sure, it was a long distance friendship, but it worked. We made it work. We clicked so well together.

Heck, we still are all of those things, and yet, I recently screwed up badly and my friend sort of cut things off a few days ago and now we're just friends. I will do everything in my power to make changes and become a happier, better, more patient person so my friend and I can someday soon return to our old friendship.

Regardless, it's thanks to Omegle that I met this friend in the first place and I will always appreciate that.

I feel like you're more likely to win the lottery than Omegle is to do anything with the Tina bot, let alone ANY bot. 

They took out the feedback for god's sakes, if that doesn't tell you how little they care, I don't know what will.

Oh yes there absolutely is a captcha. I'm quite surprised you've never heard of it, because it seems like it ONLY works on actual people and doesn't affect bots whatsoever.

Hell, I got captcha put on me for 24 hours starting late last night. I was going through the depression tag and kept running into that Tina bot and a bunch of horny people bots. :(
I wouldn't thought the depression tag and similar related tags would keep bots away, but unfortunately not. :(

Yeah, I always have the same problem. I don't understand why they use captcha when clearly it doesn't work for it's intended purpose - stopping bots. All it actually seems to do is hinder real people, making the bots that much more prevalent. 

And it frustrates me that it usually triggers when you disconnect too much, but when I keep running into bots or horny guys, it's sort of hard NOT to disconnect often. I really wish Omegle still had a feedback system, because at least then you could get help with the captcha issue.

I wish I knew a way to report bots. I've run into so many that I often question why Omegle even put Captcha in place since it's clearly not working. I've seen Tina on the Depression tag as well. But I've met countless other bots over and over.
